<!-- pr-reviewer: 418e88034c8cc834ae745691e6f6b26e950618b7 -->

Needs changes before merge.

**What looks good**
- The pin asserts the real property. `tilted_holes_in_a_plate_are_not_drilled_along_z` checks that `recognize` finds no Z hole, and that `recognize_cross` finds no cross hole. It does not only check for a message. It covers 2, 5 and -2 degrees, in 1, 2 and 8 bands.
- The fixture is honest. `tilted_wall_builder_at_zero_tilt_is_a_z_hole` shows that the same builder gives one Z hole at 0 degrees. A drop below is the tilt's verdict.
- No test is weakened or removed. The change adds one test module and one `mod` line. There is no `#[ignore]`. The new test code has no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`.
- The body has `Changelog: none` (test-only) and `Fixes #3554`. The subject is conventional: `test(motion): ...`.

**Mutation check (I ran it)**
- I set `recognize::FIT_TOL` in `crates/motion/src/drilling/recognize.rs:44` from 0.02 to 0.5. The 2 and 5 degree walls then pass the Z circle fit, and `recognize` returns them as Z holes.
- `tilted_holes_in_a_plate_are_not_drilled_along_z` went RED at `crates/motion/src/drilling/tests_tilted.rs:81`:
```
thread 'drilling::tests_tilted::tilted_holes_in_a_plate_are_not_drilled_along_z' panicked at crates/motion/src/drilling/tests_tilted.rs:81:5:
a tilted hole must not pass as a Z hole: [Hole { xy: Point2 { x: 10.174604, y: 15.0 }, radius: 3.003453, entry_z: 10.0, floor_z: 0.0, through: true, stepped: false }, Hole { xy: Point2 { x: 30.437443, y: 15.0 }, radius: 3.021609, entry_z: 10.0, floor_z: 0.0, through: true, stepped: false }]
```
- I restored the file. `git show HEAD:crates/motion/src/drilling/recognize.rs | cmp -` reports identical, and `git diff --stat` is empty. The pin passed again. So the pin can fail, and it fails on the wrong cut that it guards.

**Results merged with main (locally; `origin/main` 4dba7019d; trial merge clean)**
- Build: `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib --no-run` - ok.
- Full touched binary: `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib` - 570 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored.
- Pinning tests by name: `tilted_wall_builder_at_zero_tilt_is_a_z_hole` ok, `tilted_holes_in_a_plate_are_not_drilled_along_z` ok, `a_tilt_the_fit_accepts_moves_no_wall_past_fit_tol` ok.
- Clippy: RED.
```
error: this function has too many arguments (8/7)
  --> crates/motion/src/drilling/tests_tilted.rs:16:1
   |
16 | / fn tilted_wall(
17 | |     cx: f64,
...
25 | | ) -> Vec<Triangle> {
   | |____________________^
   = note: `-D clippy::too-many-arguments` implied by `-D warnings`
error: could not compile `camcraft-motion` (lib test) due to 1 previous error
```
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): `light build (release --no-run)` ok, `motion light: lib` (the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light) ok, `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` (wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes_light) ok. 3 steps, 0 failed.

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/motion/src/drilling/tests_tilted.rs:16` - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` fails with `too_many_arguments (8/7)` on `tilted_wall`. The batch tier runs clippy, so a merge would turn `main` red at the post-merge gate. Fix: add `#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]` on `tilted_wall` (the production `classify` uses the same allow at `crates/motion/src/drilling/recognize.rs:242`), or pass the centre as one `(cx, cy)` point and the band as one small struct.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The commit says `Refs #3554` and the PR body says `Fixes #3554`. Both are fine; GitHub closes the issue from the body.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
